title: Workflow status on Model Health
description: Model Health now shows the latest key GitHub Actions runs, including model refreshes, archive updates, results, odds, and Pages deployment.

title: Player and field skill context
description: DataGolf reference skill components are available on Player Drilldown and as a sortable current-field table in Event Drilldown.

title: Live UK odds board
description: Odds & Value now compares active model players with live Bet365 and Sky Bet prices, while Player Drilldown adds archived opening and closing odds where available.

title: Last week’s betting P/L
description: The homepage now groups realised profit and loss by tournament and backed player for the latest settled week.
